import json,sys
from PIL import Image,ImageChops
a=Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert('RGBA'); b=Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert('RGB')
assert a.size==b.size==(1920,1080)
rgb=a.convert('RGB'); hist=ImageChops.difference(rgb,b).histogram(); pooled=[sum(hist[c*256+i] for c in range(3)) for i in range(256)]; total=sum(pooled); mean=sum(i*n for i,n in enumerate(pooled))/total; acc=0;p99=255
for i,n in enumerate(pooled):
 acc+=n
 if acc>=total*.99:p99=i;break
bands=ImageChops.difference(rgb,b).split(); ph=ImageChops.lighter(ImageChops.lighter(bands[0],bands[1]),bands[2]).histogram();pa=0;pp99=255
for i,n in enumerate(ph):
 pa+=n
 if pa>=a.width*a.height*.99:pp99=i;break
print(json.dumps({'width':a.width,'height':a.height,'rgbSamples':total,'mae':mean,'p99':pp99,'pooledRgbP99':p99,'max':max(i for i,n in enumerate(pooled) if n),'alphaExtrema':a.getchannel('A').getextrema(),'note':'MAE uses RGB channel absolute differences; p99 uses the maximum channel difference per pixel. Pooled per-channel p99 is separately recorded.'}))
